description: Use when an agent needs what price did after past liquidation cascades. Returns a symbol's events with 15 m, 1 h, 4 h and 24 h forward returns, n, mean, median, hit rate, a bootstrap interval and a random-time baseline. Not charged on 400, 404 or 503. Costs 0.5 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

cooldown_min.description: minutes without a qualifying window before the next event can start, 15 to 1,440, default 60

limit.description: events listed, largest first, 1 to 100, default 20; the statistics always use every event

min_usd.description: USD liquidated inside the window, 10,000 to 1,000,000,000, default 100,000

side.description: which liquidations count: long, short or both (default both)

symbol.description: BTC, ETH, SOL or any symbol the backtest covers (default SOLUSDT); a symbol it does not cover answers 400 with the list that works

window_min.description: rolling window in minutes, 1 to 60, default 5

name: get_cascade_backtest

data.description: the get_cascade_backtest payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_cascade_backtest

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload
